events.verdict: Bridges (NYK) cleanly blocks Powell's (MIA) driving shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) briefly grasps Ware's (MIA) arm as they engage for rebounding position.
Wiggins (MIA) does not maintain verticality and he initiates contact with Towns' (NYK) arm that affects his play at the basket.
Towns (NYK) establishes himself in Mitchell's (MIA) path prior to the contact.
Ware (MIA) and Towns (NYK) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Shamet (NYK) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Mitchell's (MIA) hand that is on the ball, as he defends the drive.
Hart (NYK) cleanly deflects the ball away from Wiggins (MIA) as they pursue the rebound.
Shamet (NYK) commits a take foul on Mitchell (MIA).
Hart (NYK) establishes himself in Wiggins' (MIA) path prior to the contact.
Mitchell (MIA) legally contests McBride's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Ware (MIA) and Hart (NYK) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.

Defensive goaltending is called on Ware (MIA) and the crew utilizes the goaltending/basket interference replay trigger. After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) is overturned to an inadvertent whistle. Ware cleanly blocks Towns' (NYK) shot attempt while the ball is on its upward flight to the basket.  At the time of the whistle, neither team had imminent possession and play resumes with a jump ball center circle.
Wiggins (MIA) cleanly dislodges the ball from Towns (NYK).
Ware (MIA) legally contests Towns' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) and Bridges (NYK) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Hart (NYK) makes clean contact with the ball as Mitchell (MIA) secures the rebound.  The ensuing body contact occurs after the expiration of the game clock.
